objective: Get a reviewer's second opinion on a reported package name/version string before trusting it.

steps.objective: Read Cargo.toml and report the package's name/version you find, then ask the consultant to double-check it.
expectedOutputs: agent-result.json (status, summary) naming the package's name and version
agent-report.md: a short human-readable report stating the name and version you found

steps.objective: Independently re-read Cargo.toml and confirm or correct the requester's reported name/version.
expectedOutputs: agent-result.json (status, summary) confirming or correcting the requester's finding
agent-report.md: a short human-readable report confirming or correcting the requester's finding
